title: Clean public documentation claims

context.summary: Remove stale task-era and temporary wording from public documentation.
context.background: Public docs must describe the current runnable product and concrete remaining work without promising unavailable supported behavior.

in: Update README, repository status, support matrix and architecture/process docs.
Remove stale references to early skeleton, placeholder and later-task wording from public supported paths.
Keep historical PRD task sections only where they are clearly historical and not current product claims.
Update docs so experimental means implemented but requiring extra resources or credentials.
Remove TASK-89-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.

acceptance_criteria: Public docs distinguish supported, experimental and future capabilities using current implementation facts.
Supported paths do not describe temporary scaffolding as runtime behavior.
Docs provide a clean local run path and clear public release status.
No task-era stale wording remains in current public product descriptions.

manual_checks: Confirm README can be handed to a new GitHub user without internal task context.
Confirm future sections do not describe supported product behavior.

risks: Docs cleanup must not hide real limitations.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
